title: Muling Umawit ang Puso
description: Aunor, a former star actress, plans to stage a comeback with the help of her niece while Aunor's boyfriend exposes a mayoral candidate who runs a sex trafficking network.

title: Pro Boys
description: A 1995 romantic comedy directed by Jake Tordesillas.

title: Akin Ang Ulo Mo Kid Manalo
description: A hapless taxi driver in Manila becomes the target of a bunch of armed men when a passenger leaves a case full of money in his cab.

title: Babangon Ang Huling Patak Ng Dugo
description: After his family is killed, a teacher heads for the mountains to find peace. There, it becomes clear to him that the injustice is much deeper-rooted than he believed.

title: LagLag Barya Gang
description: Ike Lozada struggles to earn enough money to take care of unhoused children in his care and teaches them to be street hustlers. However, he faces unexpected challenges when the kids are kidnapped.

title: Parañaque Bank Robbery: The Joselito Joseco Story
description: Joselito Joseco is a security guard who is committed to his duty at a local bank. When a gang of criminals robs the bank, Joselito takes them on at the risk of his life.

title: Anak ni Baby Ama
description: A boy grows up not knowing his real identity. One day a mysterious lady, claiming to be his real mother, divulges the truth about his roots. He is caught between leaving his past and living his new life.

title: Sid and Aya: Not a Love Story
description: A successful stockbroker who suffers from insomnia hires a woman to keep him company during his long, sleepless nights.

title: Squad Goals
description: Five boys face the same troubles in their love and high school lives. They decide to come together and solve their problems.

title: Coming Soon
description: Strange events befall people who watch a horror movie.

title: Luck At First Sight
description: Jonas and Diane, two unlucky cash-strapped strangers, meet and realize that they are each other's lucky charm. They take advantage of this, only to discover a disappointing catch.

title: DoReMi
description: Three girls divided by personalities, cultural backgrounds and principles have one thing in common: their love for music.

title: Ikaw Lang
description: A librarian's husband and mother-in-law turn out to be psychotically abusive. When the husband mistakenly thinks he has killed her, he dumps her in a river, where she is saved by a fisherman. Now she wants revenge and teams up with a bank robber.

title: Sa Hirap at Ginhawa
description: A 1984 drama featuring Sharon Cuneta and Gabby Concepcion.

title: Tikboy and Pamboy
description: Tikboy and Pamboy, two boys orphaned at a very young age, grow old together and experience the challenges, joys and sorrows of life.

title: Balandra Crossing
description: Kiko and Tisoy, who are government agents, follow the trail of a criminal syndicate after it uses counterfeit cash to complete a transaction.

title: Teniente Gimo
description: The villagers of the town of Dueñas believe that Teniente Gimo, the town leader, belongs to a clan of demonic creatures called 'aswang'. Together, they plan to eliminate him and rid the village of danger.

description: A needy and fatherless boy enjoys the benefits of working for a wealthy man, until he is asked to commit murder.
